matchup.plan_title: Plan (22:15 UTC 20 Nov): the deadline is the day's first tip-off, and Murphy is still questionable
matchup.plan_md:
**What changed since 04:50 UTC:**
- **Add deadlines moved earlier.** ESPN locks this league's rosters at the **first NBA tip-off of each US day**, and a player added after that counts only from the next day. That comes from `mSettings` (`rosterLocktimeType` FIRSTGAME_SCORINGPERIOD) and from the league's transactions: team 7 added Jeremiah Fears at 4:51 PM ET on 31 Oct, after the 3:00 PM first tip and before his 7:00 PM game, and he was not on their roster that day. The earlier plan gave each player's own tip-off; `matchup.py` now gives the first tip-off.
- **Jalen Suggs is gone** (Lauri Birds). The Sunday fallback is now **P.J. Washington**.
- **Score:** **900 to 874**, up 26, after a correction on their side.
- **Murphy is still questionable.** He is listed with bilateral patellar tendinopathy on the official report at 4:45 PM ET ([NBA injury report, 20 Nov 4:45 PM ET](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-20_04_45PM.pdf)). He has missed six straight games. Return: no timetable reported beyond "a chance to return Friday" ([NBC Sports](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-19/trey-murphy-knee-questionable-friday-vs-thunder)); *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.

**Deadlines** (Melbourne; the first NBA tip-off of each US day):

| US day | First game | Adds for that day close |
|---|---|---|
| Fri 20 Nov | CHA @ ATL, 7:00 PM ET | **11:00 AM Sat 21** |
| Sat 21 Nov | MIL @ PHI, 1:00 PM ET | **5:00 AM Sun 22** |
| Sun 22 Nov | DET @ ATL, 3:30 PM ET | **7:30 AM Mon 23** |

**The plans scored** (our lineup over 20–22 Nov; they score 701; adds: 4 of 7 used, **3 left**):

| Murphy | Plan | Moves | Lineup | Final |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| **Plays Fri and Sat** | **Keep Murphy** | Gobert → Murphy (Fri); Bey → Queta, Missi → Mara (Sun) | **909.6** (846 + 63.6) | **about 1,810 to 1,575** |
| Plays Fri and Sat | Most points, any route | Gobert → Murphy (Fri); Murphy → Queta, Missi → Mara (Sun) | 909.5 (800 + 109.5) | about 1,810 to 1,575 |
| **Ruled out Fri** | **Stream** | Gobert → Mara (Fri); Mara → Queta (Sat); Missi → Washington (Sun) | **900.0** (839 + 61.0) | **about 1,800 to 1,575** |
| Out Fri, added anyway | Add Murphy | Gobert → Murphy (Fri); Bey → Queta, Missi → Mara (Sun) | 874.6 (811 + 63.6) | about 1,775 to 1,575 |
| — | No moves | — | 800 | 1,700 to 1,575 |

**Verdict:**
- **Murphy confirmed in before 10:55 AM: add him.** Keeping him ties the best route.
- **Ruled out, or still undecided at 10:55 AM: add Mara.** Adding Murphy blind beats Mara only if he is at least 73% likely to play Friday: 909.6 × p + 874.6 × (1 − p) = 900.0. A questionable player who has missed six straight games is below that.
- Every row wins on projection.
- **Plan line:** 2 adds.

**Times, Melbourne:**
1. **By 10:55 AM Sat 21** (adds close at 11:00 AM):
   - **Murphy playing:** drop **Gobert**, add **Trey Murphy III**.
   - **Out or undecided:** drop **Gobert**, add **Aday Mara**.
2. **If Mara:** after NO @OKC ends (tip-off 12:00 PM Sat), drop Mara and add **Neemias Queta** before **5:00 AM Sun 22**.
3. **Sunday, after NO @SA ends** (tip-off 12:00 PM Sun 22), before **7:30 AM Mon 23**:
   - **Murphy played both nights:** drop **Bey** for **Queta**, and **Missi** for **Mara**.
   - **Murphy played Fri, sat Sat:** drop only **Missi** for **Queta**.
   - **Mara route:** drop **Missi** for **P.J. Washington**.

**Sunday risk:** Queta's Sunday game is the second night of Boston's road back-to-back, and he has rested 1 of 4 back-to-backs. If Boston lists him out before 7:30 AM Mon, add Washington instead.

**Form:**

| Player | Rate | Season | L7 | L15 | L30 | ESPN proj. |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Trey Murphy III | 35.1 | 31.0 (9) | — | 38.5 (2), small sample | 31.0 (9) | 36.8 |
| Rudy Gobert | 24.2 | 25.4 (15) | 20.2 (4) | 24.1 (7) | 25.4 (15) | 34.3 |
| Saddiq Bey | 34.9 ‡ (rate 34.6) | 30.4 (16) | 41.0 (4) | 32.1 (8) | 30.4 (16) | 25.9 |
| Yves Missi | 27.6 | 32.0 (5) | 25.7 (3) | 25.7 (3) | 32.0 (5) | 24.7 |
| Neemias Queta | 31.9 | 27.3 (14) | 38.0 (2), small sample | 29.3 (6) | 27.8 (13) | 27.2 |
| Aday Mara | 31.6 | 27.1 (15) | 34.3 (3) | 33.3 (7) | 28.0 (14) | — |
| P.J. Washington | 28.8 | 28.2 (15) | 29.3 (3) | 28.3 (7) | 28.2 (15) | 26.9 |

**Why the L7s are 5+ off the season:**
- **Bey, +10.6:** starting at 37.8 min (29.6 for the season) with Murphy out.
- **Mara, +7.2:** about 25 min with Chet Holmgren out (*ESPN est.* 2 Jan).
- **Queta, +10.7:** two games, a small sample.
- **Missi, −6.3:** minutes unchanged (20.7, against 20.2); no other reason found.
- **Gobert, −5.1:** minutes unchanged (29.0, against 29.3); no other reason found.

- **Kel'el Ware:** his 19 Nov start was a one-off. Myles Turner is expected back Sat 21 Nov ([RotoWire, 19 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/myles-turner-injury-sidelined-by-left-shoulder-contusion-540024)); *ESPN est.* 21 Nov.
- **Saddiq Bey:** his start lasts only while Trey Murphy III sits.

- **Yves Missi:** still on a minutes limit of about 22.
- **Paul George:** sat both earlier road second nights. Sun 22 at GS is a road second night, a pattern risk only.

**Free agents in the plan:**
- **Trey Murphy III** is **questionable** for Fri at OKC, upgraded from out ([NBA injury report, 19 Nov 10:45 PM ET](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-19_10_45PM.pdf)); *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.

**Snow Time Lakers:**
- **Jaylen Brown** is re-evaluated before Sat vs MIL and could be cleared; *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
